title: Faithful Word
story:
A young student once prepared for an important exam.

He studied from many books.

Some books gave confusing answers.

Different sources said different things.

He became unsure what to trust.

Then his teacher gave him one main textbook.

She said,

“Focus on this. It is reliable.”

The student followed it carefully.

He stopped depending on random notes.

And he gained clarity.

On exam day, he felt confident.

In life, we hear many voices.

Different opinions.

Confusing advice.

Changing truths.

But God is not confusing.

His Word is right.

His works are faithful.

Everything He says is trustworthy.

And it never fails.
life_lesson:
God’s Word is always right and trustworthy.

Build your life on His truth.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for Your faithful Word.

Help me to trust what You say above all other voices.

Remove confusion from my heart.

Guide me to walk in Your truth every day.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Are you influenced by many confusing voices in life?

How can you rely more on God’s Word today?

What truth from God do you need to trust right now?
verse:
For the word of the Lord is right and true;
He is faithful in all He does.
